snippet.title: Scrap Daddies Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Grab your best friends and dive into the colorful, vibrant, and violently chaotic world of Scrap Daddies, a new looter-shooter from Other Ocean. Get in, get scrap, and get back alive… if you can! Teamwork is paramount as you explore eerie undersea ruins in search of the artifacts that keep New Tortuga alive. As you race the clock, you’ll take on subterranean slimes, ruthless combat droids, and all manner of deadly hazards. Choose the right weapons, tools, skills, and upgrades to unleash your full Scrapper potential and overcome anything standing between you and victory. Manage your inventory carefully - and keep your weapons close. The more you raid, the more powerful you and your crew become… if you’re careful. Push too hard and you might not make it back to the sub alive. Stop to consolidate your gains, and you might miss out on even greater treasure.

TAKE CO-OP LOOTING TO NEW DEPTHS

-Hilarious, adrenaline-fueled 6-player raids
-Explore and plunder unique underwater bases
-Use your trusty ripsaw to get scrap for epic upgrades
-Use tools to find all power cells to escape while the base crumbles and burns around you

Scrap Daddies is coming soon to Early Access on Steam. Wishlist now to be ready on day one!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923190/Scrap_Daddies
Discord: https://discord.gg/uX8mNrEB3Y 
Instagram/Reels: https://www.instagram.com/scrapdaddiesgame/
Threads: https://www.threads.com/@scrapdaddiesgame
